final_topology.title: High-Frequency Trading Infrastructure
final_topology.description: Supports high-frequency trading with market data ingestion, processing, and order routing to three main sites.
final_topology.topology_summary: The topology includes a central data center for processing, connected to multiple exchange data feeds and three main sites for order execution. It emphasizes resilience and clear data flow.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Management System' (n26) that manages and tracks assets across various zones, including servers, workloads, and endpoints.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes detailed data flow links (e.g., nl1, nl2, etc.) and zone links (e.g., zl1, zl2, etc.) that document data flows between different components and zones.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for different types of data processing and storage, such as 'Data Center' (z1), 'Non-Production' (z7), and 'Management' (z6).

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: A firewall (n5) is implemented in the 'Data Center' (z1) and manages traffic to and from other zones.

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: A DNS server (n16) is present in the 'Data Center' (z1) and is used for DNS resolution (nl19).

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: A remote access management service (n_struct4) and a VPN gateway (n27) are present in the 'Remote Access' zone (z10), indicating that MFA is likely required for remote access.

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: A DNS filter (n17) is present in the 'Data Center' (z1) and is used for DNS filtering (nl20).

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: A web proxy (n18) is present in the 'Data Center' (z1) and is used for web proxy filtering (nl21).

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for different functions (e.g., data center, management, non-production) and uses firewalls, routers, and other security devices to enforce segmentation and least privilege.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes management servers (n13, n26) and secure network protocols (e.g., management links using management and monitoring link types).

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: An AAA server (n19) is present in the 'Management' zone (z6) and manages AAA for the firewall (n5) and admin workstation (n20).

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: A VPN gateway (n27) is present in the 'Remote Access' zone (z10) and is connected to the remote access management service (n_struct4).

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Dedicated Computing Resources for All Administrative Work
controls.evidence: The 'Management' zone (z6) includes a management server (n13) and an admin workstation (n20) that are logically separated from other zones.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: An IDS/IPS (n14) is present in the 'Data Center' (z1) and monitors various components (e.g., n1, n2, n3, n4).

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes a firewall (n5) and various management and data flow links that indicate traffic filtering between different zones (e.g., zl1, zl2, zl3, zl4).

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes an access control policy manager (n28) in the 'Remote Access' zone (z10) and a remote access management service (n_struct4) that manages access control for remote assets.

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The SIEM (n15) is present in the 'Data Center' (z1) and collects monitoring data from various components (e.g., n1, n2, n3, n4).

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Prevention Solution
controls.evidence: A NIPS (n21) is present in the 'Data Center' (z1) and monitors the market data ingestion server (n1).

controls.title: Deploy Port-Level Access Control
controls.evidence: A port-level access control (n23) is present in the 'Data Center' (z1) and manages access control for the market data ingestion server (n1).

controls.title: Perform Application Layer Filtering
controls.evidence: An application firewall (n24) is present in the 'Data Center' (z1) and performs application layer filtering for the market data ingestion server (n1).

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for production ('Data Center' z1) and non-production ('Non-Production' z7) systems.

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: A penetration testing process (n29) is present in the 'Penetration Testing' zone (z13) and is connected to various components, indicating that periodic external penetration tests are performed.

findings_before.title: empty_zone_without_node
findings_before.missing_reason: Zone z7 has no concrete node assigned to it.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add one representative concrete node in this zone and connect it with node_links to the nearest hub, firewall, router, or management/security node.

findings_before.title: ig3_missing_ig2_zone_semantics
findings_before.missing_reason: IG3 topology removed or failed to preserve IG2 zone semantics.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add the missing IG2 zone semantics to IG3 as preserved or stricter zones, with representative nodes and concrete node_links. IG3 may add controls but must not reduce segmentation.

findings_before.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes various nodes and zones, but there is no explicit evidence of an asset inventory system or process.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit asset inventory system or process is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing an asset management system and links to all other nodes to indicate asset tracking.

findings_before.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes a remote access management service (n_struct4) in the 'Remote Access' zone, but there is no explicit evidence of a VPN.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit VPN node or link is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a VPN service and links to the remote access management service and other relevant nodes.

findings_before.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes an AAA server (n19) and remote access management service (n_struct4), but there is no explicit evidence of access control policies.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit access control policies or mechanisms are shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add nodes or links representing access control policies and mechanisms.

findings_before.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes a pentest workstation (n25) in the 'External Testing' zone, but there is no explicit evidence of a penetration testing process.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit penetration testing process or schedule is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a penetration testing process and links to the pentest workstation and other relevant nodes.
